remarks: Fish, Swim, Kayak on your own private lake. Look for sign on property marked lot #4. This lot is  1710 feet Above Sea Level and has spectacular sun sets! 40' Hemlock and Hardwood trees. Located within 2 miles of 18 Hole Golf Course (Shamrock Hills), 7 Miles from Kissing Bridge Ski resort, 8 miles from Sprague Brook Park. Has access to Western New York County Snow mobile trails in Winter. Check out drone video and survey located in pictures. Property taxes are unknown as this parcel is being split off a large parcel and will be assessed by town after sale and transfer of deed.
